prompt:
Continue @Video1 from its final instant with the next 30 seconds of this same stylized 3D Chinese animation. The following timeline starts at 0 seconds of the new continuation, corresponding to 30 seconds in the episode. Preserve the existing camera position, characters, wet costumes, props, lighting and spatial layout at the join. Lu Zhao starts with both bare hands gripping the wooden wedge beneath the drum, with his original short hemp-handled awl resting on the ledge. His palms stay bare and shoulder cloth intact. The soundtrack consists of synchronized Mandarin dialogue, water, breathing, cloth and wooden mechanism sounds. Keep the picture clean for later Chinese subtitle compositing.
@Image1: Wen Xi, woman wearing pale mint green, wet clothes.
@Image2: the grey-bearded older worker, wet clothes.
@Image3: Ali, young man wearing blue, wet clothes.
CAMERA: At 0s match the exact camera and body positions of the previous segment ending. Continue the take through pulling the wedge, dropping the stone onto its shelf, locking the ankle rope and pinning Ma Duo wrists. At 6s make an explicit same-angle time-ellipsis cut to the already-wrapped wrist rope and final knot. At 7.5s tilt gently to the ember mark and retrieval of purse and awl. At 11.5s track back to the established foot stops. At 13.5s cut to Wen Xi lips at water level. At 14.5s cut to the intact right copper face and follow the straight thrust and withdrawal. At 16.5s cut to the outside wide view. From 16.5s to 30s use a single continuous rescue take following the opening door, Wen Xi climbing, both helpers lifting the worker and Lu Zhao supporting Ali knee. Move sideways and slightly forward to keep hand and knee supports visible. Finish on the four people together on the raised ledge.
CONTINUATION TIMELINE:
[0–1.5s] The awl rests visibly on the ledge above Lu Zhao's hands. Then he pulls the projecting brake wedge outward with both hands; the drum starts turning and the rope tightens.
[1.5–4.0s] Return to the established low side angle. The weight drops a handspan onto the catch-frame as the ratchet clicks forward. Then the rope draws Ma Duo's ankles together and he falls backward into shallow water, releasing the fork. The seated pawl prevents the drum from unwinding after the stone rests on its frame; the ankle loop stays tight and the fork remains in the fixed beam.
[4.0–6.0s] Ma Duo struggles to reach the embedded fork. Then Lu Zhao drops beside him, pins his chest with a knee and presses both wrists firmly against the low post while the ankle rope remains taut; another struggle still leaves the weapon out of reach.
[6.0–7.5s] An explicit same-angle time cut skips the repetitive wrapping. The short rope is already around the wrists and post and Lu Zhao still pins the chest with his knee. Then he tightens the final knot and eases his knee; Ma Duo's wrists remain secured to the post.
[7.5–11.5s] Lu Zhao rises as a thin amber mark glows beneath his sternum; the bound soaked Ma Duo strains in the background. Then Lu Zhao presses his chest, hears the remembered old man's voice, looks toward the copper lock, retrieves the purse with his left hand into his belt and takes the same awl from the ledge with his right.
[7.8–11.3s] remembered elderly male voice off screen says in Mandarin: “胜过真敌，直刺添一痕。”
[11.5–13.5s] Lu Zhao returns to the same ledge position, with the recovered purse secured at his waist. Then he braces both heels on the same wooden stops and aligns the same awl with intact copper just right of the earlier dent.
[13.5–14.5s] Water trembles at Wen Xi's lower lip; her lantern rests against the upper lip of the inspection opening. Then she closes her mouth and raises her eyes as her pounding hand drops.
[14.5–16.5s] The old dent at left and intact copper at right share the frame with the awl. Then both hands push straight; the awl pierces the intact copper and displaces the wooden tongue visible behind it. The latch tooth drops and the awl withdraws along its entry path.
[16.5–19.5s] Cut wider on the falling latch. Lu Zhao steps sideways on the raised west ledge and tucks the awl into his belt clear of the door swing. Then the inside water pushes the door open and runs along the central lower floor toward the south sump. The bound Ma Duo is visible at the side of the southern post base, his head above the flow and away from its central path. Lu Zhao braces the door edge with his shoulder and reaches his right hand toward Wen Xi; the lantern stays on the inside opening ledge.
[19.5–24.0s] Wen Xi already has one knee on the raised ledge and Lu Zhao holds her forearm; the old worker waits against the threshold. Then she climbs the last step and joins Lu Zhao, each supporting one side of the worker as they bring him onto the ledge. The worker sits; she immediately points back inside for Ali.
[23.0–23.8s] Wen Xi with synchronized lips says in Mandarin: “阿砾！”
[24.0–28.0s] Ali clings to the inside jamb with his leg caught below the threshold. Wen Xi kneels on the ledge and anchors Lu Zhao by his belt. Then Lu Zhao plants both knees, grips Ali's forearm with one hand and lifts his knee over the sill with the other. Ali rolls onto the ledge coughing water while Lu Zhao stays braced beside him.
[28.0–30.0s] All three rescued people share the raised ledge: Wen Xi supports the grey-bearded worker and Ali raises his head after coughing. The pierced copper plate remains attached to the opened lock. Then Ali takes a full breath and Lu Zhao's shoulders relax; the survivors' breathing overtakes the water sound before the cut.
